name: Inkroost: Comic & Manga Maker
official_name_basis: ChatGPTのプラグイン詳細画面に表示された名称
original_description: Make comics, manga, webtoons, manhwa and graphic novels from your own story, then turn a chapter into an anime or cartoon episode with voices and music. Plan a series with consistent characters and settings, pick a look from pictures, watch each page arrive in the chat or beside it, and keep the drawings you like with one click. Add accessible text and submit finished chapters for moderation. For an episode, watch examples first, then review and approve a plan before anything is animated. Your series also live in the sidebar.
description_scope: ChatGPTの詳細画面に表示された提供元の英語説明。
summary_ja: 物語から漫画やウェブトゥーンのシリーズを企画・作画し、章を声や音楽付きのアニメにする機能を案内する。
limitations_ja: 完成章の審査提出や、アニメ化前の計画確認・承認について記載。機能欄はInteractive, Read, Write。実動作・品質・料金・権利条件は未検証。
